const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Generate the fixed-instance Stack3RubiksCubeTask action trajectory."""
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_robolab import Session
+
+
+def bounds_center(s, name):
+    b = np.asarray(s.objects()[name]["bounds"])
+    return (b[0] + b[1]) / 2, b
+
+
+def move(s, p, xyz, quat):
+    p["move_ee"](
+        xyz, quat, speed=0.18, max_dq=0.09, tol=0.007,
+        rot_tol=0.08, max_steps=180,
+    )
+
+
+def pick(s, p, name, yaw):
+    center, _ = bounds_center(s, name)
+    quat = p["top_down_quat"](yaw)
+    p["open_gripper"](10)
+    move(s, p, [center[0], center[1], 0.16], quat)
+    move(s, p, [center[0], center[1], 0.012], quat)
+    p["close_gripper"](18)
+    move(s, p, [center[0], center[1], 0.16], quat)
+    return quat
+
+
+def place(s, p, name, support, quat):
+    center, bounds = bounds_center(s, name)
+    base, base_bounds = bounds_center(s, support)
+    target_center_z = base_bounds[1, 2] + (bounds[1, 2] - bounds[0, 2]) / 2 + 0.002
+    tcp_to_cube = s.ee_pose()[0] - center
+    target = np.array([base[0], base[1], target_center_z]) + tcp_to_cube
+    move(s, p, [target[0], target[1], 0.17], quat)
+    move(s, p, target, quat)
+    p["open_gripper"](15)
+    p["hold"](8)
+    move(s, p, [target[0], target[1], 0.17], quat)
+    p["hold"](8)
+
+
+def main():
+    s = Session("stack3_rubiks_cube", instance="/app/instance.json")
+    p = s.primitives()
+    s.record_start()
+    q2 = pick(s, p, "rubiks_cube_2", 0.584)
+    place(s, p, "rubiks_cube_2", "rubiks_cube", q2)
+    q1 = pick(s, p, "rubiks_cube_1", 0.47)
+    place(s, p, "rubiks_cube_1", "rubiks_cube_2", q1)
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, "/app/output/trajectory.npz")
+    print(f"Saved {len(actions)} actions; status: {s.status()}", flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
